short: Shanti Pappas specializes in digestive health and weight management. As a National Board Certified Health Coach and advanced certified functional medicine nutritionist, she takes a holistic approach to nutrition and wellness, creating personalized food and lifestyle plans to support lasting health improvements.
certs: National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach (NBC-HWC); advanced certifications from The School of Applied Functional Medicine; Certified Quantum Coach.
training: B.A. in History; Certificate in Holistic Health Coaching from the Institute for Integrative Nutrition; advanced functional medicine certifications from the School of Applied Functional Medicine. Additional continuing education in digestion, nutrition, and functional medicine.
pricing: Pricing varies by individual needs and coaching program. A free 20-minute discovery call is available to discuss goals, suitable program options, and fees. Most programs begin with a 3-month commitment. Contact Happy Belly Health for current pricing.
long: Shanti Pappas is the Digestion and Weight Expert since 2010. I help busy people like you finally resolve digestion and weight issues for good. I am a national board certified health coach and advanced certified functional medicine nutritionist. This means that I know what I am doing and I am confident I can help you feel and look your best for good. I take a holistic approach to health and wellness. I look at each area of your life and how that connects to your symptoms, challenges and concerns. I then put together a specific plan for you to make lasting food and lifestyle shifts that can help improve your energy restore your balance and enhance your health.
